newsitem.title: USA: CME Sept lumber hits limit-down on weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CME Sept lumber hits limit-down on weak cash.

text.p: CME September lumber futures touched down the $10 per tbf limit in late trading, weighed down by the weak cash market and technicals, traders said.
The market was under pressure from the open following the $8 per tbf lower cash quote from Random Lengths. Added technical pressure developed under the 40-day moving average, traders said.
September touched limit down at $364.00 and traded at $365.50, off $8.50, at 1259 CDT.
Limitless July was at $372.00, down $8.20, and other months were $5.60 to $9.00 lower.
